description: HAL ADC1 IN0 (PA0, analog) single conversion every 100 ms after HAL_ADCEx_Calibration_Start; prints 'adc=<raw> mv=<mV>' on USART1
expect: 72 MHz, ADCCLK = PCLK2/6 = 12 MHz. ADC1 independent mode, no scan, single conversion, software start, right aligned, channel 0 (PA0 in analog mode) sampled 55.5 cycles (conversion 68 ADCCLK = 5.67 us). After HAL_ADCEx_Calibration_Start (RSTCAL then CAL) a conversion is started every 100 ms (deadline based, no drift; the first right after init), EOC is polled and USART1 PA9/PA10 115200 8N1 prints 'adc=<raw> mv=<mV>\r\n' with raw = round(V(PA0) / VDDA x 4095) and mV = (raw x 3300 + 2047) / 4095 (VDDA assumed 3.3 V). PA0 at 0 V -> 'adc=0 mv=0', at VDD -> 'adc=4095 mv=3300'; a potentiometer between 3V3 and GND reads position x 4095.

circuit: PA0: nothing else connected (the scenarios drive it; tests/mcu/stm32f1/adc-firmware.test.ts wires a 10 kohm potentiometer between 3V3 and GND with its wiper on PA0 instead)
USART1: virtual terminal on PA9 (TX) / PA10 (RX)

scenarios.name: PA0 tied to 3V3 reads full scale
